title: Memory and context: influence without authority, and a view that is not state
note: Both modules exist to keep one thing from becoming another. Memory must never become evidence; a context must never become the record. The mutations that matter are the ones that erase the distinction quietly -- Y5, where an invalidated source stops making what was derived from it stale, and X3, where mandatory material is dropped to make a prompt fit, so a decision is made without the policy that governed it and nothing says so.
